snippet.title: Whispers in the Bitter Frost - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's a psychological horror mystery RPG. Dive into a mysterious chilling experience in Lord Ricardo's Manor, where you save yourself from some sinister secret ready to entrap you forever into darkness.

Download Whispers in the Bitter Frost on itch:
https://starmage.itch.io/whispers-in-the-bitter-frost
